• Provide the original payment reference, merchant, date, charged amount and currency. [Source: policy://DEMO-CANCEL/2.0#C1]

• A cancellation request does not by itself establish that cancellation was effective before the charge. Conflicting dates or records require human review. [Source: policy://DEMO-CANCEL/2.0#C3]

• This policy describes evidence collection only. It does not establish dispute eligibility, a chargeback deadline, liability or a refund entitlement. [Source: policy://DEMO-CANCEL/2.0#C4]

This is general evidence-collection guidance, not a decision about your account, eligibility or refund.
